Definition: Percentage of respondents who own a bank account in their own name.
Interpretation: Higher values indicate greater reported bank-account ownership. Ownership does not necessarily indicate active account use.

Definition: Percentage who describe themselves as a registered mobile-money user (the first response option of question F5).
Interpretation: Registered users who have never used the service, or who no longer use it, are separate F5 categories and are not counted here. The figure is therefore lower than the published headline for registered mobile wallets.

Definition: Percentage who reported borrowing money in the past 12 months.
Interpretation: Measures recent borrowing activity from any source, not access to formal credit. Borrowing is not automatically positive or negative.

Definition: Percentage classified as not saving by any mechanism.
Interpretation: A financial-vulnerability signal, not a direct measure of access to savings services.

Definition: Percentage of respondents who report setting aside emergency or rainy-day funds.
Interpretation: A financial-resilience signal. It does not measure the amount saved or whether funds would cover a major emergency.

Definition: Percentage of respondents who report saving with a group, such as a cooperative, VSLA, tontine, or ikibina.
Interpretation: Measures participation in group-based saving, not the adequacy of savings or overall financial inclusion.

Definition: Percentage of all respondents who currently use an Umurenge SACCO. Respondents who never used one are counted as non-users.
Interpretation: Reflects use of the sector-level SACCO network in the full adult sample. Ever-use is also available in the district table.

Definition: Percentage of all respondents who currently use a savings group they save with or borrow from. Respondents who never used one are counted as non-users.
Interpretation: Compare with 'Saves with a group', which comes from a different question and gives a somewhat higher national figure.

Definition: Weighted percentage answering Yes to current use of a mobile-money operator among the 4,915 valid responses to this routed item.
Interpretation: Routed from mobile-money ever-use. Skipped respondents are excluded, not counted as No; margins use indicator-specific valid response counts.

Indicator: Sent or received money via mobile money
Definition: Weighted percentage answering Yes to sending or receiving money via a mobile-money operator among the 4,915 valid responses to this routed item.
Interpretation: Measures transfer activity among respondents with valid answers, not all-adult use or number/value of transactions. Skips are excluded.

Definition: Weighted percentage reporting borrowing from a group such as a cooperative, VSLA, tontine or ikibina in the past 12 months.
Interpretation: A distinct informal borrowing source; it is not equivalent to formal credit customer counts or to all-source borrowing.

Definition: Weighted percentage reporting medical insurance including RAMA, MMI or Mediplan.
Interpretation: NBR active policyholder counts include all insurance types and are source-specific administrative counts, not medical coverage prevalence.

Definition: Weighted percentage reporting ever-use of an Umurenge SACCO using the full eligible survey population.
Interpretation: Ever-use is broader than current use. NBR active SACCO branches provide infrastructure context only, not membership or usage.

Definition: Weighted percentage reporting ever using a savings group the respondent saves with or borrows from using the full eligible survey population.
Interpretation: Not equivalent to reporting current group saving and not directly comparable to SACCO-only administrative infrastructure.

Definition: 100 minus the weighted bank-account ownership estimate.
Interpretation: Percentage not reporting bank-account ownership. Derived measure; the dashboard compares districts with the national estimate instead.

Definition: 100 minus the weighted registered mobile-money estimate.
Interpretation: Percentage not classified as a registered mobile-money user. Derived measure; the dashboard compares districts with the national estimate instead.
Percentage not reporting borrowing in the past 12 months. Derived measure; the dashboard compares districts with the national estimate instead.
